# vertical_outpaint (vendored)

`vertical_outpaint.py` and `vertical_reframe.py` are copied unchanged from Phosphene v5.0.16
(checkout remote: github.com/mrbizarro/phosphene-beta), MIT licence, Copyright (c) 2026 Mr. Bizarro (see LICENSE here).
They hold the geometry, ffmpeg arguments and frame blending for "Make it vertical" with AI fill.
The model calls are ours (see the runner next to the engine file), written from the recipe in
vertical_outpaint.py's docstring, which follows Lightricks' own In/Outpainting IC-LoRA workflow.

The IC-LoRA weights are Lightricks' (LTX-2 Community License, see Phosphene's LICENSES folder).
